AVATAR_LAST_SUBTITLE: Move each group's avatar down beside its last bubble, like Messages
BUBBLE_COLOR_FALLBACK: Follows the theme: a shade darker than the chat's background
GROUPING_SUBTITLE: How one author's messages in a row sit together
JOIN_CURVES_SUBTITLE: Fill the step under a wider neighbour's corner with an inward curve, so the group reads as one shape
LAYOUT_CARD_SUBTITLE: One card behind each whole message, name and reactions included, like Rosiecord
LAYOUT_FIT_SUBTITLE: Each bubble wraps just the text and media of its message
MEDIA_CONCENTRIC_SUBTITLE: The bubble's corners grow to curve around the media's
MEDIA_FLUSH_SUBTITLE: The bubble ends at the media's edge, with the media's corners
MEDIA_NONE_SUBTITLE: The bubble keeps its own corners around the media
MEDIA_REROUND_SUBTITLE: The media's corners shrink or grow to match the bubble's
NAME_INSIDE: Name and reply inside the bubble
NAME_INSIDE_NEEDS_ROOM: Turn on Make room for padding to use this
NAME_INSIDE_SUBTITLE: Show the author's name, the time and the message being replied to at the top of the group's first bubble
PREVIEW_FRIEND_FIRST: Have you seen the new bubbles?
PRESET_JOINED_SUBTITLE: A group's bubbles touch and read as one shape
PRESET_MESSAGES_SUBTITLE: Round bubbles a few points apart, square only where they meet by the avatar
PRESET_REPLACE_BODY: Your shape, grouping and colors change to this preset. Mention settings stay.
PRESET_ROUNDED_SUBTITLE: Every bubble fully round, set apart from the next
PRESETS_DESCRIPTION: Start from a look, then fine-tune it below
ROOMY_ROWS_SUBTITLE: Spaces messages apart and lines bubbles up with the author's name, so every bubble keeps its full padding
ROUND_EXPOSED_SUBTITLE: Round a right corner that reaches past the bubble next to it
ROUND_OUTER_SUBTITLE: Keep every right corner round, squaring only the side by the avatar where bubbles meet
SMOOTH_STEPS_SUBTITLE: Widen a bubble to a neighbour that reaches past it by less than the corner radius
